title: OPEN-SET RECOGNITION: A GOOD CLOSED-SET CLASSIFIER IS ALL YOU NEED?
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper's benchmarks are for open-set visual recognition and do not measure any aspects of faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on the computer vision task of open-set recognition.
